name: v1.6.8
body:
## 10/26/2026

### Changed

- Updated the runtime to Node 26.12.1 and Python 3.14.9, with Debian Chromium 156.0.8078.47.
- Updated Claude Code to 2.1.307, Gemini CLI to 0.65.0, OpenAI Codex to 0.163.0, Junie to nightly 3888.1 and OpenCode to 1.19.3.
- Updated GitHub CLI to 2.103.0 and refreshed compatible npm and Python packages.
- Removed the Prisma mysql2 and PM2 js-yaml replacement steps. Prisma 7.10.1 supplies mysql2 3.24.4, and PM2 7.1.0 supplies js-yaml 4.3.2 through their official package trees.
- Updated the optional Full-derived Docker client recipe to Docker CLI 29.9.2 and Compose 5.6.1.
- Kept Node and Python Playwright aligned at 1.64.0. CloudCLI features and the existing FFmpeg security patches remain unchanged.
- Kept Go 1.27.1 for the existing custom esbuild binaries. A toolchain update remains deferred.

### Security

- Refreshed immutable input bindings for v1.6.8 and retained checks of the official Prisma and PM2 dependency trees.
- Updated Syft to 1.55.0 and Grype to 0.121.0. Dependency reports still list accepted upstream vulnerabilities with their installed versions. These remain unresolved.
